angular-fesm-packages.source: @angular/* 13.0.0 through 19.2.10 ship fesm2022 maps whose sources are ../../../../../../packages/<pkg>/src/…, with no Bazel directory (19.2.11 and later name the Bazel directory, which the angular-bazel rule names); composed by a bundler, they climb two or more ../ into packages/<pkg>/ (spec §10).

next-webpack-build.source: Next webpack builds compose next's shipped maps to webpack://_N_E/../../src/build/…, which no framework path rule names (spec §10).

next-webpack-lib.source: Next webpack builds compose next's shipped maps to webpack://_N_E/../../src/lib/…, which no framework path rule names (spec §10).

next-webpack-shared.source: Next webpack builds compose next's shipped maps to webpack://_N_E/../../src/shared/…, which no framework path rule names (spec §10).
